_meta.prompt: User wants old pre-nerf versions of items, 'cool to see' grail pieces, and real history. Sources include the ogd2barb YouTube channel and community forums. Stats here are research notes and NEED a verification pass before any card is written.
sources: youtube: 'Pre-Patch Time Travel - Barb Shows Forgotten Items [Diablo 2 History]' (ogd2barb)

theme_legacyPreNerf.definition: Legacy items come from patch 1.09 or earlier. They are the pre-nerf versions of items whose stats were reduced in 1.10 (or another patch). They can no longer drop. They exist only on Non-Ladder, one pool per realm, and expired accounts have deleted most since 2001-2003, so survivors are extremely scarce. This is the 'old version before the nerf' collector category.

items.name: Legacy Hellfire Torch (25% Firestorm)
items.old: 25% chance to cast Firestorm on striking
items.note: Iconic pre-nerf proc rate. Verify exact proc level and the patch that cut it. The current Torch is common knowledge, the legacy 25% version is a collector curio.

items.name: Legacy Wizardspike (+95 all resistance)
items.note: Clean, well-documented pre-nerf unique. Strong candidate. Distinct from the shakier 'Mephisto-fused Wizzy' folklore entry already in the pool, consider replacing that one with this.

items.name: Siggard's Stealth (the renamed Nosferatu's Coil)
items.story: Pre-1.10 the good belt was called Nosferatu's Coil. On patching to 1.10, every existing copy was RENAMED to Siggard's Stealth, and a new, different Nosferatu's Coil started dropping in its place. The rename swap itself is the story.
items.note: Great curio. Sources disagree on exact old stats (life steal %, IAS). Verify before writing.

items.name: Legacy pre-1.10 charms (impossible affixes)
items.examples: Small charms with the inertia suffix (+5% Faster Run/Walk, removed from small charms in 1.10). Charms with Pestilent + Anthrax rolling ~451 poison damage over 12 seconds. Affix combinations the current game will not generate.
items.note: A collector category: charms whose affixes can no longer exist. Could be one entry covering the idea, anchored on one concrete example.

items.name: Pre-1.07 no-level-requirement uniques
items.story: No uniques had a character-level requirement before v1.07. A pre-1.07 Bul-Kathos' Wedding Band, Shako, etc. would carry no level requirement at all, usable from level 1.
items.note: More of a mechanic/history note than a single item. Could anchor a card, or fold into another legacy entry.

classicRareBows.name: Classic rare bows (the Ghoul Stinger era)
classicRareBows.finding: Carrion Bow, Ghoul Bow, Ghoul Stinger and the like are NOT specific items. They are rare (yellow) bows whose two-word name is randomly generated from a fixed pool (first-names include Ghoul, Carrion, Corpse, Bone, Death; missile second-names include Bow, Stinger, Song). The name has no bearing on the affixes. Each was a one-off random roll, which is why no canonical stat sheet or screenshot exists.
classicRareBows.whyItMatters: In classic D2, before Lord of Destruction and runewords, a top-rolled rare bow was the bowazon endgame. There was no Windforce to chase. Great rares became personal legends and their random names became folklore.
classicRareBows.representativeChaseRoll: What made a classic rare bow legendary: high +% Enhanced Damage, +max damage, Increased Attack Speed, large +to Attack Rating, and often Knockback. No +skills on classic rares.
classicRareBows.note: Frame as a history / hidden-value hybrid about rare bows as the classic-era grail, not as one item with fixed stats.
